responsibility: Defines the x86 AVX-512 4VNNIW intrinsic API for four-source word dot-product accumulate operations used in vector neural-network workloads. It enables avx5124vnniw and provides masked and unmasked wrappers for vp4dpwssd and vp4dpwssds builtins, serving as the public intrinsic layer for this narrow AVX-512 subextension distinct from the more general AVX-512 VNNI headers.
